description: A team's upcoming fixtures, home and away. `url` is the match's page on weekendgoals.com, listing every seller and price we hold.

currency.description: The currency to show prices in: the one the user wrote their budget in or uses where they are. When absent, maxPrice's currency, else USD.

limit.description: How many matches to return, 20 unless given, at most 50.

team.description: The team's name, for example Benfica. A name not found may be known as written in its own country, for example Bayern München, with any suffix such as U19.

name: team_next_fixtures
title: A team's next fixtures
